ownershipCoverage.rule: Main players are those projected above 0 points who are not listed out; a source is used when the players it names hold at least 80% of their total projected points.

recipes.projection: Blended projection = weighted mean of Sleeper app x1, CBS Sports x1, ESPN fantasy x1, DraftKings points converted from each source's own stat lines. Weights renormalise over the sources that cover each player; coverage is the covering weight as a share of the total enabled weight. Coverage under 50% keeps the number from the sources that do cover the player and is flagged "thin"; it is never pulled toward a typical score for the salary. A player no ticked source covers has no projection: it is left blank, flagged "no projection" (0 when the injury report lists him out, on IR, doubtful or suspended); his DraftKings average per game never stands in.
recipes.scoring: DraftKings scoring from stat lines; 100/300-yard bonuses paid as 3 x probability from a lognormal (cv rush 0.55, rec 0.55, pass 0.30); DST points-allowed from a normal around the opponent's implied total (SD 9.5, shutout rate unvalidated)
